_comment: JustMySocks (or any xray-compatible) nodes. Copy to nodes.json. Every node needs id/name/address/is_enabled/protocol/secret_id plus the block matching its protocol. The secret itself — the Shadowsocks password or the VLESS uuid — is sealed in the credential vault as a token object; secret_id names it, and a node whose reference does not resolve is omitted from the rendered config the way a disabled one is.
_comment_import: The panel's Proxy page decodes ss:// and vless:// share links into this file, sealing each link's secret on the way.

nodes._comment: Shadowsocks node. JustMySocks SS endpoints look like ss://<base64 of method:password>@host:port#name
nodes.name: Example SS node

nodes._comment: VLESS + Reality node. reality.public_key is the pbk= parameter, short_id the sid=, server_name the sni=, fingerprint the fp= from the vless:// link.
nodes.name: Example VLESS node

balancer._comment: strategy: leastPing picks the lowest-latency node (needs the observatory probe), roundRobin cycles, random picks per connection.
